items.title: Failure of geometric reducedness of the generic fibre persists over a dense open
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism over an irreducible base, if the fibre over the generic point is not geometrically reduced then every fibre over a nonempty open fails to be geometrically reduced. The proof argues by contradiction using the spreading result for geometric reducedness: if some fibre in every neighbourhood were geometrically reduced, the spreading property would force the generic fibre to be geometrically reduced, contradicting the hypothesis. Using the positive spreading result to prove the negative statement is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 7188-7212.
